notes.title: Andarin Weppes Full Release!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Andarin Weppes 1.0 is out now!

To celebrate the full release and the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase participation, Andarin Weppes will be discounted during the launch week. Don't miss out on the 40% discount running from May 29 to June 5th!

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2516890/Andarin_Weppes/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

notes.title: Andarin Weppes is out now on Early Access!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Andarin Weppes is out right now on Early Access!

Don't miss out on the 20% discount for the launch! The discount will be running from June 19th, 10 AM PDT to July 3rd, 10 AM PDT!

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2516890/Andarin_Weppes/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

The game currently features 19 levels with unique puzzles that will have you scratching your head. We plan to use the Early Access period for gathering feedback and fixing bugs. We appreciate any and all feedback you can send our way! We'll be keeping an eye on the Steam Discussions page for your feedbacks.

Hope you enjoy Andarin Weppes! 🧸

notes.title: Andarin Weppes: Pre-Dementia is Out Now! Play for Free!
notes.content:
Experience the beginnings of dementia as the illness starts to invade your mind in Andarin Weppes: Pre-Dementia!


Get a taste of Andarin Weppes and play through 6 levels for free on Andarin Weppes: Pre-Dementia. Feel your mind warp your environment further and further with each obstacle surpassed.

Click the widget below to download Andarin Weppes: Pre-Dementia for free!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361510/Andarin_Weppes_PreDementia/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget


Don't forget to wishlist Andarin Weppes!

notes.title: 🧸 Step into the tangled mind of a dementia patient! Join the stream!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Join the stream on our Steam page and watch the developer play Andarin Weppes.


The demo will also be publicly available during Next Fest, so don't forget to try it out for yourself!

The demo currently features 7 levels that introduce the puzzle mechanics of Andarin Weppes. Step into the tangled mind of a dementia patient and traverse through the non-Euclidean environments of your late grandpa's house.


Don't forget to wishlist Andarin Weppes if you enjoy the demo!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400281/2a560b6bd4ebc9df5dda9818301da1d199f1b082.png
